# 5th Kalasha International Film & TV Awards

The 5th Kalasha Film and Television Awards ceremony, presented by the Kenya Film Commission, honoured the best in Kenyan television and film for the year 2014. It took place on 25 July 2014 at the National Museum in Nairobi, Kenya. The awards recognize excellence in storytelling, direction, performanceand technical execution in the Kenyan entertainment industry.
The feature film Strength of a Woman and the short film Simiyu Samurai 2 were the biggest winners of the night, taking home three awards each. In the television categories, the drama series Saida secured Best TV Drama, while veteran actor Lenny Juma was honoured with the Lifetime Achievement Award.
Ceremony
The 5th edition of the awards ceremony was held on 25 July 2014 at The National Museum in Nairobi. The gala celebrated outstanding achievements across film, televisionand special categories. The event was officially hosted by media personalities Jeff Koinange and Patricia Amara, guiding the audience through the night's recognitions.
